acceptance_checks: A read-only claude -p reviewer is dispatched before create_pr and emits a structured verdict; parse/dispatch failure is fail-closed (blocks, never passes).
The loop records a code-review ledger + writes the ## Pre-PR code review PR-body section; CCA PR-12 + MergeGate required_skill=code-review pass.
Blocking findings drive the existing repair loop (3-limit); contract test covers clean + blocking-findings paths; suite green.
scope: Add an independent read-only code-review verifier run before create_pr (ADR 0011, Q1/Q2): a reviewer dispatch (claude -p, --allowedTools restricted to read tools, --json-schema structured findings verdict) in a separate context, as a reviewer runtime distinct from the bypassPermissions implementer adapter (scripts/shiki_runtime_adapters.py). The loop parses the verdict deterministically (parse/dispatch failure = fail-closed -> block), records a code-review ledger, and writes the '## Pre-PR code review' PR-body section (scripts/shiki_github.py github_pr_body) from it. Blocking findings feed the existing repair loop (verdict -> repair packet -> fix -> re-review), bounded by the 3-attempt limit.
title: Independent code-review verifier (read-only claude -p)
